aviation_incidents.headline: 美國聯邦航空總署要求部分波音737 NG定期測試數位飛行控制系統 指令估影響約300架美國註冊飛機
aviation_incidents.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署發布適航指令2026-23-04，要求部分波音737 NG定期執行副翼內建測試，必要時修正並複測。擾流板位置資料遺失或出錯可能使自動油門的巡航推力差監控無法啟動；若兩具引擎推力差距過大，飛機可能意外滾轉，機組員未及時察覺並修正恐失控。指令估計影響約300架美國註冊飛機，將於聯邦公報刊登後15天生效。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: FAA orders recurring flight-control tests on certain Boeing 737 NG aircraft, with about 300 U.S.-registered aircraft estimated to be affected
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration has issued airworthiness directive 2026-23-04, requiring recurring aileron built-in tests on certain Boeing 737 NG aircraft, with corrective action and retesting as necessary. Missing or faulty spoiler-position data could prevent the autothrottle’s cruise thrust-split monitor from activating. A large difference in engine thrust could then cause an unexpected roll and, if the crew fails to identify and correct the condition in time, loss of control. The directive is estimated to affect about 300 U.S.-registered aircraft and takes effect 15 days after publication in the Federal Register.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 長榮航空波音787-9新機 B-17891 傳已自查爾斯頓啟程前往桃園機場
taiwan_aviation.summary: 消息指出，長榮航空波音787-9新機 B-17891 已自美國南卡羅來納州查爾斯頓啟程，目的地為桃園國際機場，並稱這是長榮今年第二架新機，航程仍待確認。長榮前一架新交付的787-9 B-17890於今年3月11日交機，截至11月1日機隊有9架787-9及13架787-10。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: EVA Air’s new Boeing 787-9 B-17891 reportedly departs Charleston for Taoyuan
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: A tip says EVA Air’s new Boeing 787-9 B-17891 has departed Charleston, South Carolina, for Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport and is the airline’s second new aircraft this year. The reported departure remains unconfirmed. EVA’s previous newly delivered 787-9, B-17890, was handed over on March 11; its fleet included nine 787-9s and 13 787-10s as of November 1.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 中華航空連續11年獲APEX全球五星航空肯定 並首度獲大中華區最佳座椅舒適度獎
taiwan_aviation.summary: 中華航空連續11年獲國際航空乘客體驗協會（APEX）全球五星航空肯定，並首度獲大中華區最佳座椅舒適度獎。華航表示，即將引進的787新機將升級客艙，豪華商務艙設獨立包廂，豪華經濟艙配包覆式椅背，經濟艙設13.3吋4K螢幕。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines earns 11th straight APEX global five-star honor and first best seat comfort award for Greater China
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines received APEX’s global five-star airline recognition for the 11th consecutive year and its first best seat comfort award for Greater China. The airline says its forthcoming 787 aircraft will have upgraded cabins, including individual premium business-class suites, wraparound premium-economy seatbacks and 13.3-inch 4K screens in economy.

international_aviation.headline: SkyWest將CRJ200改裝為41席CRJ450 首架預計2026年底前投入聯合航空支線定期航班
international_aviation.summary: SkyWest計畫將現有龐巴迪CRJ200改裝為41席CRJ450，預計到2028年完成約50架；首架預計在2026年底前以聯合航空旗下United Express品牌投入定期航班。新客艙規劃7席頭等艙、16席加大腿部空間的經濟艙及18席一般經濟艙，並設手提行李櫃與Starlink Wi-Fi。
international_aviation.headline_en: SkyWest plans 41-seat CRJ450 conversions from CRJ200s, expects first in United Express service by end of 2026
international_aviation.summary_en: SkyWest plans to convert about 50 Bombardier CRJ200s into CRJ450s by 2028, with the first expected to enter scheduled service under United Airlines’ United Express brand by the end of 2026. The planned 41-seat cabin will have seven first-class seats, 16 extra-legroom economy seats and 18 standard economy seats, plus a carry-on luggage closet and Starlink Wi-Fi.

international_aviation.headline: 美國眾議院中國問題特別委員會籲限制對中國航空業投資 報告點名空中巴士
international_aviation.summary: 美國眾議院中國問題特別委員會11月19日建議限制對中國航空產業投資，並呼籲美國聯邦航空總署不予認證中國製飛機。委員會認為西方業者與中方的部分合作有助中國發展軍用航空能力，建議撤回持續投資該產業承包商的美國政府合約；報告點名空中巴士。相關措施仍屬建議，須待美國政府採取後續行動。
international_aviation.headline_en: U.S. House China panel urges limits on investment in China’s aerospace industry, names Airbus
international_aviation.summary_en: On November 19, the U.S. House Select Committee on China recommended limiting investment in China’s aerospace industry and urged the Federal Aviation Administration not to certify Chinese-built aircraft. The panel argued that some Western partnerships had helped China develop military aviation capabilities and recommended withdrawing U.S. government contracts from contractors that continue investing in the sector. Airbus was among the companies named. The proposed restrictions require further government action to take effect.

sources.name: 美國眾議院中國問題特別委員會

international_aviation.headline: 航空短訊：Rostec宣布向俄羅斯航太軍交付新一批Su-57戰機 聯合航空為713架飛機裝設Starlink 泰雷茲以三地據點支援亞太航空業
international_aviation.summary: Rostec宣布向俄羅斯航太軍交付新一批Su-57戰機；聯合航空已有713架飛機裝設Starlink，約占機隊47%，其中352架為支線客機，目標2027年底完成全機隊安裝；泰雷茲以新加坡、北京及新德里據點支援亞太機隊，並以越捷航空維修合約說明在地備料有助縮短等待時間。
international_aviation.headline_en: Aviation briefs: Rostec announces Su-57 delivery to Russian Aerospace Forces, United equips 713 aircraft with Starlink, Thales details Asia-Pacific support
international_aviation.summary_en: Rostec says it has delivered another batch of Su-57 fighters to the Russian Aerospace Forces. United Airlines has equipped 713 aircraft, including 352 regional jets, with Starlink, accounting for about 47% of its fleet, and aims to complete installation across the fleet by the end of 2027. Thales supports Asia-Pacific fleets through sites in Singapore, Beijing and New Delhi, citing its Vietjet maintenance agreement as an example of how local parts stocks can reduce waiting times.

new_information: Rostec, the parent company of United Aircraft Corporation (UAC), announced that it had delivered another batch of Sukhoi Su-57 fifth-generation fighters.
The announcement said another batch of Sukhoi Su-57 fighters had been delivered to the Russian Aerospace Forces.
This was the third Su-57 delivery UAC had publicly announced in 2026.
The company did not disclose how many aircraft were handed over, as with the previous two deliveries.
Rostec said Russian Ministry of Defense pilots evaluated the fighters in various flight modes.
Rostec said the aircraft had upgraded onboard systems and weapons, including low-observable cruise missiles.
